videos.title: The Hour of Transfer
videos.overview: Without explanation, Eun Ho's power drains away after her encounter with Si Yeol. She soon appears before him again, demanding that he make a wish.

videos.title: The Rise and Fall
videos.overview: After giving away his wish to Hyun U Seok, Si Yeol enrages Eun Ho — and wakes up to unintended consequences as he tries to understand his new reality.

videos.title: The Price of Good Deeds
videos.overview: Desperate for his life back, Si-yeol pleads with Woo-seok to reverse the wish. But Jang Do-cheol kidnaps Si-yeol - putting him and Eun-ho in peril.

videos.title: The Changer, the Changed, and the Lacking
videos.overview: Eun-ho and Si-yeol head to the mountains in search of another fox that could help. But they encounter a figure from her past that shocks her.

videos.title: The False Kindness
videos.overview: Si-yeol and Eun-ho clash over Geum-ho's plan, each trying to persuade the other that their way is better — and what it means to be human.

videos.title: The Revenge of Memory
videos.overview: After surviving a near disaster, Eun-ho and Si-yeol begin to develop a bond. Soon, they try to turn their luck around by stepping up their good deeds.

videos.title: The Hobby Called Love
videos.overview: Eun-ho's confession and subsequent actions leave Si-yeol feeling overwhelmed. But after spending quality time together, they end up going on a date.

videos.title: Love Attack
videos.overview: After their kiss, Eun-ho and Si-yeol navigate the awkward aftermath. Meanwhile, Do-cheol uses Woo-seok to get one step closer to Eun-ho.

videos.title: From Chance to Destiny
videos.overview: Pagun approaches Eun-ho with a sobering truth about Si-yeol and Woo-seok's fate — forcing her to find a way to change destiny as her feelings evolve.

videos.title: The Way of Humans
videos.overview: During a date at a soccer game, Eun-ho runs into Lee Yoon — shocking Si-yeol. Meanwhile, Do-cheol uses Geum-ho to obtain the fox bead.

videos.title: Love Without Regret
videos.overview: Eun-ho makes a fateful decision to save a dying Si-yeol. Now facing eternal separation, will they ever find their happily ever after?
